reason: The README identifies oh-my-dsh as a community directory and registry for discovering, filtering, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with automated metadata collection and catalog generation.

summaries.zh: oh-my-dsh 是一个用于搜索、筛选和安装 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件的目录与机器可读注册表。
summaries.en: oh-my-dsh is a directory and machine-readable registry for discovering, filtering, and installing DeepSeek Harness community plugins.

capabilities: Indexes and catalogs DeepSeek Harness plugins
Provides search and filtering for plugin discovery
Refreshes repository and npm metadata through automated scripts
